notes: Overall: a real step up from rc.1 (avg 3.25 to 3.67). Every rc.1 blocker is fixed on every screenshot. What is left is a second layer of problems the rc.2 rules created or did not reach: dead space in the header bands, notes whose arrows point at nothing, a hatch you cannot see in light mode, mobile tables that hide columns with no hint they scroll, and dark-mode lift and switch thumbs that disappear. It still misses the bar (avg >= 4.0).

rc.1 bloom clipped into a rectangle: FIXED everywhere. Blog home, commerce home and dashboard overview, desktop and mobile, light and dark: the bloom leaves only through the right edge of the viewport, and no straight bottom or container edge is visible. The light bloom (lavender-grey wash, rim, grain) clearly echoes the reference p1 bloom. It is smaller and sits higher than the reference: about 25% off-canvas against the analysis's 40-60%. That is acceptable for a derivation.

rc.1 muddy dark bloom: FIXED in the narrow sense. On blog, commerce and dashboard dark it now reads lighter than the page. But mn-wash-night is just a 10px blur, so the dark bloom is a soft out-of-focus blue cloud with no paper edge and no pigment pooling. It reads as a glow, not watercolor, and the dark theme loses most of the reference's character.

rc.1 whole titles in serif: FIXED. 'Overview', 'Projects', 'Team', 'Profile', 'Notifications', 'Security', 'Billing', 'Your cart' and the product titles are all sans. Serif appears only in 'Field *Notes*' (with swash), the blog article titles ('...Twelve *Teams*', '...Actually *Read*'), the one blog pull-quote per article, and 'Shop all *goods*'. That is exactly the per-app list.

rc.1 collapsed inputs: FIXED. Blog 'Search posts' and the newsletter field are 40px. The dashboard 'Filter projects' field is 40px, and the agent chose that over the toolbar's 32px to match the segmented control. The header 'Search projects…' field is 32px with a matching button. Commerce sort select is 36px to match the chips. Settings fields are 40px.

rc.1 mobile nav and overflow: FIXED. Dashboard and settings show product name + avatar + two-line menu button at 390px; blog (2 links) and commerce (2 links + cart) fit. The no-horizontal-scroll gate passes and the captures are 780px wide (2x). But the overflow moved into the table frames. Team mobile cuts 'Engineering Mana…' and hides Location and Active projects. Settings security mobile shows the Revoke buttons only as 4px slivers at the right edge. Settings billing mobile cuts the Status column to 'Stat' and shows only the badge dots. Nothing tells the user these frames scroll (no edge fade, no partial-column cue), so status and the destructive action are effectively hidden.

rc.1 clip-art placeholders: FIXED and now identical in blog and commerce (tray, small centered outline image icon). New problem: in light mode the hatch is invisible. color.border.default #e6e4de on color.surface.tray #e9e6df is about ΔE 1, so every light placeholder is a flat beige slab. The commerce grid is 11 identical beige boxes, and the 780x585 product image frame is one big empty rectangle. In dark (#2e2d28 on #2a2925) the hatch is visible. So the spec recipe works in only one theme, which is a spec gap.

rc.1 no pencil notes: FIXED in count. There is one note per app: blog 'start here', commerce 'made for every day', dashboard 'this month so far', settings 'everything lives here'. Placement is weak, though. On blog home the arrow points down into the empty band about 200px above the featured card, at nothing. On dashboard overview the arrow points down into the empty gap between the lead and the KPI cards, not at the period ('October 2026') or at an action. Commerce points at the lead line (fine), and settings points up toward the nav (fine). The recipe says 'arrow toward its target' but gives no geometry for reaching it.

rc.1 switch off-state: FIXED in light (tertiary border reads). NEW in dark, settings notifications desktop and mobile: the off thumb is color.surface.raised #1d1c18 on a #24231f track, so the thumb vanishes. The off switch reads as an empty outlined pill, and you cannot tell which side the thumb is on.

rc.1 hierarchy items: FIXED. Product and project titles use the object h1 (44). Projects no longer repeats 'All projects'. The Apollo Migration 'Active' badge sits inline in the meta line. The throughput chart card now fills to match Recent activity.

New: header band dead space. The recipe's .bloom-band min-height 320px plus padding-top 64 leaves about 130-200px of empty paper between the lead and the first content. This happens on dashboard overview (KPIs start at y=393), commerce home (filters at y=393) and blog home (FEATURED at y=457). On a dashboard that pushes the data down for decoration. The dashboard agent flagged it and kept it because the recipe says so.

New: dashboard overview chart. Six full-height solid ink slabs (about 70px wide, near-black in light, paper in dark) are the heaviest object on the page and outweigh the KPI values and the h1. The reference keeps ink mass to buttons and small chips. In dark the paper bars glare.

New: dark pinned lift is invisible. On billing dark the Pro 'current plan' card and on blog home dark the featured card are almost indistinguishable from resting cards: shadow.pinnedNight on #151410 has nothing to darken. The light theme reads correctly.

Mobile details: on dashboard overview mobile, 'DEPLOYMENTS THIS MONTH' wraps to 2 lines, so '186' sits about 14px lower than '99.94%' in the neighboring card. The stacked project rows have 'Due date' selected as the sort chip, but due dates are not shown in the blocks, so the list is sorted by an invisible key. The in-page 'Search projects…' row sits above the h1 on every dashboard route (Overview, Projects, Team, project detail) and pushes the title down by about 80px. The commerce and settings sticky bars are built correctly (52px buttons, bar surface, page bottom padding). Their overlap in the full-page captures is a capture artifact.

Spacing and alignment: in the blog article, the code block under 'Migrating without a freeze' sits about 8px under the preceding paragraph, while every other block gets 16-24px. The blog container is 1280 (content x=80-1360), while commerce and dashboard use 1360 (x=40-1400) and settings uses 960. The featured blog card spans about 8 of 12 columns and leaves a dead right column, which is exactly where the note should live. Settings security: the password inputs are 400px inside a full-width card (half the card empty), and the Revoke buttons are not right-aligned to the frame edge. Cart: the h1 is left-aligned while the empty panel is centered, which gives two axes.

Mono rule: mostly right. Table dates, amounts, IDs, the billing invoice columns, the dashboard spec rows and the commerce summary rows are mono. Small inconsistencies: the billing 'Amount' header is mono while the other headers are sans; the Team 'Active projects' counts look sans; the project-detail value '2 of 6 complete' sets the words in mono too; the commerce Details row '40 × 35 × 15 cm' is sans.

Component states visible in the captures: selected and unselected chip, segmented control (light and dark), ink tab underline, header current link, sorted column header, radio-card selection, disabled stepper minus, current-plan emphasis badge, status badges with dot and word, switch on and off, cart empty state (correctly without details). Focus-visible, hover, error, loading, toast and dialog are still not in the screenshot set. The agents claim them but nobody can vouch for them visually. None of the four agents ran the smoke tests (the gate ran them and they pass).

Cross-app: clearly one family. Same text-only header, same 56px page h1 rhythm with lead, the same bloom placement and size on the three landing headers, the same note voice, the same card radius and hairline, and the same badge and chip language. Gate palette 0.896 and type 0.953 match what is visible. Deviations: blog container width, settings' 960 column (an undocumented agent decision), and where each note's arrow points.
promptFixes: Header band height (spec gap, causes the dead space on dashboard, commerce and blog): replace '.bloom-band { min-height: 320px }' with 'min-height only on a landing masthead (blog home, store home): 280px. On app pages (dashboard overview, settings empty state) the band has no min-height and padding-bottom space.32; the bloom box is 420x240 at top:0, right:-100px, and may extend below the band behind the margin above the first cards but never under a card (cards get position:relative; z-index:1).' Add to Verification: 'The gap between the lead and the first content block is at most space.64.'

Media hatch in light (spec gap, makes every light placeholder a flat slab): change the hatch to 'repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-border-strong) 0 1px, transparent 1px 12px)' and require the hatch line to be at least 1.25:1 against color.surface.tray in both themes, or add a dedicated token color.decor.hatch (light #d6d3cb, dark #3a3933). Add to Verification: 'In light, the hatch is visible on every no-asset frame.'

Mobile tables (spec gap, hides status and actions on billing, security and team mobile): change Table, Mobile to 'Tables with a status column or a trailing action column always stack on mobile, whatever their column count. Scrolling frames (other tables of up to 4 columns) show a 24px right-edge fade (mask-image: linear-gradient(to left, transparent, #000 24px)) while more content is off-screen, and size column 2 so that part of it is visible as a cue.' Add to Verification: 'At 390px every status badge and every row action is fully visible without horizontal scrolling.'

Stacked rows show the sort key (spec gap): add to Table, Mobile stacked rows: 'The meta line always includes the active sort key's value (for example the due date when sorted by Due date); sort chips list only keys that appear in the block.'

Pencil note geometry (spec gap, the arrows on blog home and dashboard overview point at empty space): add to the note recipe: 'Place the note so the arrowhead ends within space.16 of its target's bounding box (the featured card's top-left corner, the period words in the lead, the primary action). The target must be in the same band or the next block. If it is more than 120px away, move the note next to the target (for example in the free grid columns beside the pinned card) instead of drawing a longer arrow.' Add to Verification: 'Every note's arrow ends on its target.'

Dark switch thumb (spec gap, contrast): in Switch States add 'Off thumb: color.text.tertiary in dark, color.surface.raised with a 1px color.border.strong ring in light; the thumb must reach 3:1 against the track in both themes. On thumb: color.text.onAction.'

Dark pinned lift (spec gap): add to Card Variants: 'Pinned in dark adds a 1px color.border.strong ring (inset 0 0 0 1px) instead of border.default, and uses color.surface.subtle as its fill so the lifted object steps up in value; shadows alone do not read on night paper.' Update shadow.pinnedNight's inset ring to #4a4840.

Dark bloom character (spec gap): mn-wash-night is a plain blur and reads as a glow, not watercolor. Keep the displacement and add a soft lighter rim: after the blur, feMorphology erode radius 4 → feComposite out → feGaussianBlur 3 → merge the rim at 1.4x the wash alpha, with no grain. Say: 'In dark the bloom keeps a visible irregular edge; it must not look like an out-of-focus ellipse.'

Charts (spec gap, the ink slabs outweigh the KPIs): add to Color use, Charts: 'Bars at most 28px wide with gaps at least 1.5x the bar width, top corners radius.inner; a single-series bar chart uses color.text.secondary for past periods and color.text.primary only for the current period; value labels font.size.caption color.text.secondary. A chart never carries more ink area than the KPI values above it.'

Stat-card alignment on mobile (spec gap): add to Card: 'Stat-card eyebrows stay on one line (white-space:nowrap; text-overflow:ellipsis) or the eyebrow row gets a fixed 2-line min-height, so values in a row of stat cards share a baseline.'

Mobile header search (spec gap, the dashboard pushes every h1 down): replace 'Header search moves into the page' with 'Under breakpoint.md, header search becomes a size.touch icon button left of the menu button, opening a full-width search field below the header; it never sits above the h1.'

Container width (agent mistake the spec already covers, strengthen it): blog used 1280. Add to Verification: 'Page content left edge at 1440px is (1440 - size.container)/2 = 40px in every app; a narrower reading column (article, settings) is centered inside the container and documented in components.md.' Also give settings an explicit width: 'Settings content max 960px, centered; header aligned to it.'
Article block spacing (spec gap): add to Typography or Code block: 'In article prose, figures, code blocks, quotes and tables get space.24 above and below; never less than a paragraph gap.'

Empty state alignment (spec gap): add to Empty state: 'Inside a page with a left-aligned h1, the empty-state panel aligns to the content column's left edge, not the viewport center, unless the page has no header.'

Mono rule (tighten): add to rule 7: 'Table headers are always sans, including over mono columns; in a value like "2 of 6 complete" only the numbers are mono (wrap them in a mono span); dimensions in spec rows (40 × 35 × 15 cm) are mono.'

Harness (process): focus-visible, hover, error, dialog and toast are still not captured, so componentStates cannot reach 4 on evidence. Add a states capture to pigment-snap: tab to the first control and to a field, submit an empty required form, open the dialog, and screenshot each, in light and dark at both widths.
